entries.label: Version 1
entries.prompt:
Design and build a world-class, single-page pre-release / waitlist website for MedHelix (medhelixapp.com), a medical education app where learners practise clinical reasoning through interactive patient cases. Tagline: "Think. Decide. Learn." Primary goal: get visitors to join the waitlist. Audience: medical students and junior doctors, on phones first.

BRAND AND COLOUR (use only these)
- #F0F0F0 page background
- #E6DFD3 warm sand for alternate sections and cards
- #E38B60 primary accent (buttons, highlights, glows)
- #D9785C deeper accent (hover, gradient end, small highlights)
- #111111 text, dark sections and the nav island
Gradients may only blend #E38B60 into #D9785C. Use #111111 text on orange buttons, since white on orange fails contrast. Never put orange text on #F0F0F0 below 24px. Body text must meet WCAG AA.

TYPE
- Headings: Plus Jakarta Sans 800, tight tracking, very large (clamp up to ~88px on desktop).
- Body: Inter 400/500, 17–18px, line height 1.6.
- One italic or serif accent word per heading to add warmth.

FLOATING ISLAND NAV (signature element)
- A pill-shaped bar floating 16px from the top, centred, with a blurred #111111 background at ~80% opacity, 1px light border, soft shadow.
- Contents: MedHelix helix mark, 4 links (Product, How it works, Features, FAQ), and a "Join waitlist" button in #E38B60.
- Dynamic behaviour:
  1. On load, the island drops in with a spring and expands from a small pill to full width.
  2. On scroll down, it shrinks to a compact pill showing the logo, the current section name, and a progress ring. On scroll up it re-expands.
  3. A sliding highlight follows the hovered or active link (shared-layout animation).
  4. On mobile, it becomes a bottom-centred island. Tapping it expands upward into a menu sheet with staggered links.
  5. Inside the nav, show a tiny live "1,284 on the waitlist" counter that morphs when the number changes.
- Use springs (stiffness ~260, damping ~24). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

PAGE STRUCTURE
1. Hero: giant headline "Learn medicine through decisions." Subline in one sentence. Email field plus "Join the waitlist" button, with a stack of overlapping patient-case cards floating behind, gently parallaxing. A looping vitals-monitor line (ECG) draws across the background in #E38B60.
2. Social proof strip: "Built with clinicians and educators" plus the waitlist count. Use placeholders for logos; do not invent partners.
3. How it works: sticky scroll section with 4 steps (History, Examine, Investigate, Treat). A phone mockup stays pinned while its screen crossfades between steps and the vitals change.
4. Feature bento grid (6 tiles of different sizes): AI patient chat, live vitals, 5-attempt hints, AI tutor debrief, XP and streaks, quick 90-second challenges. Each tile has a micro-interaction on hover.
5. Interactive demo: a mini case inside the page. The visitor picks "Order an ECG" or a wrong option and sees the patient's vitals respond.
6. Waitlist section on a #111111 background: big headline, email field, role picker (Student / Junior doctor / Educator), and a progress bar showing early-access perks.
7. FAQ accordion with smooth height animation.
8. Footer: logo, links, "Not a substitute for clinical judgement" medical disclaimer, privacy link.

WAITLIST FLOW
- Inline validation, button loading state, success state with a confetti burst in palette colours, then "You're #1,285 in line" and a share-to-move-up referral link. Clear error state with retry.

MOTION SYSTEM (every element animates, nothing jarring)
- Page load: staggered fade-up of hero text (60ms stagger), blur-to-sharp on the headline.
- Scroll reveals via IntersectionObserver; numbers count up; ECG line draws on scroll.
- Buttons: magnetic hover, a pressed scale of 0.97, and a shine sweep on the primary button.
- Cards: 3D tilt following the cursor, with a soft orange glow.
- A custom cursor that grows over interactive items (desktop only).
- Smooth anchor scrolling, section transitions with clip-path wipes.
- Everything uses transform and opacity only, targeting 60fps.
- Provide a complete reduced-motion fallback.

QUALITY BAR
- Mobile-first, then tablet and desktop. 16px side gutters. No horizontal scroll.
- Touch targets of at least 44px. Visible focus rings. Semantic HTML, alt text, aria-labels on icon buttons.
- Lighthouse 95+. Lazy-load media. Inline critical CSS.
- Original illustration and iconography only. Do not copy other brands.
- No filler copy or fake statistics: use clear placeholders such as [WAITLIST COUNT] where facts are missing.

DELIVERABLES
Single responsive page (HTML/CSS/JS or React + Tailwind + Framer Motion), the nav island as a reusable component, and a short note listing the animation tokens (durations, easings, spring values).
